intent: Individually authored pronoun-reference tasks. Learners distinguish speaker, listeners, referents and subject/object positions. Guided practice only; no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: Exact named person cards and speech bubbles encode who speaks and who belongs to each group. Code draws names and relationship paths; learners never infer identity or gender from appearance.

workshop.title: 听懂一句话，找准代词指谁
workshop.instruction: 点出代词所指的人，分清说话者、听者和被谈论的人。

items.label: someone：有个人，但还不知道是谁
items.prompt: A pair of gloves is by the gate. Its owner is unknown. Select the evidence for someone, then complete the sentence.

wordDecision.prompt: A pair of gloves is by the gate. Its owner is unknown. Select the evidence for someone, then complete the sentence.

recordPaths.label: 已知与未知分开
steps: a pair of gloves by the gate

recordSelection.title: 圈出原文确实提供的线索
recordSelection.prompt: 只圈已有证据，不圈猜出来的人名。

rows.label: Found
rows.text: A pair of gloves is by the gate.

rows.label: Owner
rows.text: We do not know the owner.

recordSelection.hint: someone允许身份未知，不能补造Bob。
recordSelection.wrong: 应圈发现手套、失主未知两条；没有证据指向Bob。

items.material: Someone left a pair of gloves by the gate.
items.after: left a pair of gloves by the gate.
items.reason: someone指某个人或有人；此处只知道手套由人留下，不知道那个人是谁。它不等于everyone。someone作主语时通常按单数处理，如Someone is waiting，不用are。原句left是leave的过去式，不能单凭left判断单复数。
items.hint: 有这个人，但不知道具体是谁；不要猜人名。

options.text: We know Bob left the gloves.
options.reason: 题目没有说是Bob，不能凭空指定人名。

options.text: A person left the gloves; we do not know who.
options.reason: 有人留下了手套，但还不知道是谁，符合someone。

options.text: Every person left a pair of gloves.
options.reason: someone表示某个人，不是所有人都做了这件事。

items.label: you：同一个词，可以指两位听者
items.prompt: Mr Li asks Ming and Amy: “Can you show us the safest path?” Tap everyone that you refers to in his question.

wordDecision.prompt: Mr Li asks Ming and Amy: “Can you show us the safest path?” Tap everyone that you refers to in his question.

recordSelection.title: 点出you所指的听者
recordSelection.prompt: 老师叫了Ming和Amy两人的名字。
recordSelection.hint: you在这里指两位听者，不指说话者。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Ming和Amy；漏一人或选老师都不符合提问对象。
recordSelection.quote: Ming and Amy, can you show us the safest path?

items.material: Can you show us the safest path?
items.reason: you可以指你，也可以指你们，词形不变。这里老师同时向Ming和Amy提问，you指两人，不包括说话的老师。us指说话者所在的一方；不能把you和us的范围混在一起。若只向Ming一个人提问，仍然用you。
items.hint: 先找谁在说，再找他对谁说；两位听者也用you。

options.reason: Mr Li正在说话；you在这句话里指他面对的听者。
老师也叫了Amy的名字，不能把她排除。

options.text: Ming and Amy, the two listeners.
options.reason: 李老师同时向Ming和Amy提问，这里的you指两位听者。

items.label: he：先找到男孩，再用主格
items.prompt: Ming tells Amy about Bob, a boy: “He found his missing glove under the bench.” Tap the person meant by he.

wordDecision.prompt: Ming tells Amy about Bob, a boy: “He found his missing glove under the bench.” Tap the person meant by he.

recordPaths.label: 人物线索与句子位置都要对

recordSelection.title: 点出He指的那个人
recordSelection.hint: 人名和动作都由文字明确给出。
recordSelection.quote: Bob is a boy. He found his missing glove under the bench.

items.material: He found his missing glove under the bench.
items.after: found his missing glove under the bench.
items.reason: He指前文明确介绍的男孩Bob，不凭离代词最近的名字乱猜。he作主语：He found...；作宾语用him：I helped him。句中his是他的，修饰glove，不能代替主语he。
items.hint: Bob是被谈论的人；he作主语，him作宾语。

options.text: Bob, the boy Ming is talking about.
options.reason: 这段话明确在说男孩Bob，He指Bob，并作found的主语。
Ming在介绍Bob，不是在说自己找到了手套。
found前缺主语，应填he；him通常作宾语。

items.label: she：她在做动作，不是her作主语
items.prompt: Ben tells Leo about Amy, a girl: “She made a label for each plant.” Tap the person meant by she.

wordDecision.prompt: Ben tells Leo about Amy, a girl: “She made a label for each plant.” Tap the person meant by she.

recordSelection.title: 点出She指的那个人
recordSelection.hint: 先看介绍的是谁，再看谁做了动作。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Amy；Ben和Leo分别是说话者、听者。
recordSelection.quote: Amy is a girl. She made a label for each plant.

items.material: She made a label for each plant.
items.after: made a label for each plant.
items.reason: She指前面明确介绍的女孩Amy，并作made的主语。宾语用her，如I thanked her；her还可表示她的，如her label。不要因为her也能表示她，就写成Her made...。人物身份来自文字，不靠外表猜测。

options.text: Ben, because he tells the story.
options.reason: Ben在讲Amy做的事，不是讲自己做了标签。

options.text: Amy, the girl who made the labels.
options.reason: 原话明确说Amy是女孩，She承接Amy作主语。
made前需要主格she；her不能在这里作主语。

items.label: it：不是找一个物品来代替
items.prompt: In “It takes patience to learn a new skill”, which activity takes patience? Select the activity, not a nearby noun.

wordDecision.prompt: In “It takes patience to learn a new skill”, which activity takes patience? Select the activity, not a nearby noun.

recordPaths.label: 形式主语与真正的活动
steps: to learn a new skill: activity

recordSelection.title: 圈出需要耐心的活动
recordSelection.prompt: 只圈活动本身，不把patience或skill这个名词当作活动。
recordSelection.hint: to learn说明做什么；patience说明需要什么。
recordSelection.wrong: 只圈To learn a new skill；It先占主语位置，并不指某件物品。

items.material: It takes patience to learn a new skill.
items.after: takes patience to learn a new skill.
items.reason: 这里It是形式主语，不必找一个具体物品与它对应。真正说明活动的是to learn a new skill：学习新技能需要耐心。可按It takes + 所需事物 + to do...理解。换成It takes time to read the notice，活动是read the notice，不是time。
items.hint: 先问“做什么需要耐心？”再找到to learn a new skill。

options.text: Patience itself is learning a skill.
options.reason: patience是耐心，不是正在学习新技能的人或活动。
这里It不指某件具体物品，而是先占据主语位置。
真正需要耐心的是学习新技能这件事；It在句首作形式主语。

items.label: we：说话者也在这个小组里
items.prompt: Ming says “We carried the empty boxes upstairs.” He carried them with Amy and Leo. Nina only watched. Tap everyone meant by we.

wordDecision.prompt: Ming says “We carried the empty boxes upstairs.” He carried them with Amy and Leo. Nina only watched. Tap everyone meant by we.

recordPaths.label: 加入说话者，排除旁观者

recordSelection.title: 点出We所指的搬运小组
recordSelection.prompt: 说话的Ming也搬了箱子；Nina只旁观。
recordSelection.hint: we包含说话者，但不等于现场所有人。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Ming、Amy和Leo；不能漏掉Ming，也不能加上旁观的Nina。
recordSelection.quote: We carried the empty boxes upstairs.

items.material: We carried the empty boxes upstairs.
items.reason: we表示我们，包含说话者，但不自动包括现场所有人。Ming和Amy、Leo一起搬箱子，所以We指三人，不含旁观的Nina。we作主语，宾语用us，如The teacher helped us。
items.hint: we一定包括说话者；是否包括其他人，要看这次活动。

options.reason: Ming在说话，也参与搬箱子；We包括他和一起搬的Amy、Leo。
we包括说话者，不能漏掉Ming。
Nina只是看着，没有参与这次搬箱子。

items.label: they：说话者在小组之外
items.prompt: Nina says “They agreed to meet outside the museum.” She is talking about Ming, Amy and Leo, not herself. Tap everyone meant by they.

wordDecision.prompt: Nina says “They agreed to meet outside the museum.” She is talking about Ming, Amy and Leo, not herself. Tap everyone meant by they.

recordSelection.title: 点出They所指的见面小组
recordSelection.prompt: Nina在讲另外三人的约定，自己不在小组里。
recordSelection.hint: 这是原话给定的三人小组；不要加入说话者。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Ming、Amy、Leo；Nina只在讲述，不在约定中。
recordSelection.quote: They agreed to meet outside the museum.

items.material: They agreed to meet outside the museum.
items.after: agreed to meet outside the museum.
items.reason: They在这里指Ming、Amy、Leo这个小组，不包括说话的Nina。不要看见多人就选现场所有人，也不要把上一题的we范围照搬。they作主语，宾语用them；在本题这种复数指代中，be动词用are或were。
items.hint: 谁在讲，谁被谈论，要分别找；本题Nina在小组之外。

options.reason: Nina是说话者，而且明确不在这个约定见面的小组里。
Nina在谈论另外三人，They承接这三人，不含Nina。
把Nina加进去就改变了原话明确给出的范围。

items.label: me：留言留给说话的我
items.prompt: Mia says to Ben: “Please leave a message for me.” Amy is nearby. Tap the person who should receive the message.

wordDecision.prompt: Mia says to Ben: “Please leave a message for me.” Amy is nearby. Tap the person who should receive the message.

recordPaths.label: 说话者与留言接收者重合

recordSelection.title: 点出留言应留给谁
recordSelection.prompt: Mia是说话者，Ben是她提出请求的对象。
recordSelection.hint: me跟着说话者变；这里不是指听者。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Mia；Ben被请求留言，Amy只是站在旁边。
recordSelection.quote: Please leave a message for me.

items.material: Please leave a message for me.
items.reason: me是I的宾格，都指说话者。这里for me表示给我，留言接收者是说话的Mia；Ben是接到请求的人。介词for后用me，不用I。动词后也可用me作宾语，如Please help me。
items.hint: for + me；接收者是说话的Mia，不是听话的Ben。

options.reason: Ben是被请求留言的人，不是for me指定的收信人。
for是介词，后面用宾格me，不用主格I。
me指说话的Mia；留言要留给她。

transfer.stem: Which set of notes gets all three pronoun references right?
transfer.passage:
AT THE CLUB ROOM
Mia says to Ben, “Please leave the map for me.”
Ben replies, “Ming and I carried boxes upstairs. We will meet you here after lunch.”
Mia writes in her notebook, “Ben and Ming have a plan. They will return at one.”

options.text: The map is for Mia; We means Ben and Ming; They also means Ben and Ming.
The map is for Ben; We means Ben and Ming; They also means Ben and Ming.
The map is for Mia; We means Mia and Ben; They means Ben and Ming.
The map is for Mia; We means Ben and Ming; They means Mia, Ben and Ming.

answer.display: The map is for Mia; We means Ben and Ming; They also means Ben and Ming.

explanation.strategy: 每换一个说话者，就重新找代词所指的人，不把上一句话的人称直接套过来。

steps.text: Mia说for me，所以地图留给Mia。Ben说Ming and I，接着用We指自己和Ming。
steps.reason: me指说话者；we也包括当前说话者，Ben的I是Ben。

steps.text: Mia记下Ben and Ming，下一句的They承接这两人；Mia没有把自己写进小组。
steps.reason: 代词要回到本句上下文找范围，不能因为三人都出现过就全选。

distractors.reason: for me由Mia说出，地图给Mia，不是听者Ben。
Ben明确说Ming and I，We指Ben和Ming，不是Mia和Ben。
They承接Ben and Ming，没有包括记笔记的Mia。

explanation.pitfall: 说话者换了，I、me、we的指向也可能变；they不自动包含现场所有人。

visual.title: 沿着说话者找回指关系
visual.caption: 相同的小组可以因说话者不同而用we或they表达。

explanation.transfer: 若Mia也参加搬箱子，而且Ben接着说“We carried the boxes”，这次we是否也包括Mia？为什么？
